items.title: Jim Hall — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I must have heard him and I was really impressed by his approach

ctx.x: But Lead Belly is a surprise to me.

Yeah. Well, I must have heard him and I was really impressed by his approach to, first of all, to guitar playing and… That’s why I like… oh, what’s the guy that has a restaurant uptown I love? Blues player.
